name: RSS Registry
description: RSS/Atom feed catalog and ingestion engine. Fetches and persists items on a schedule, deduplicates, and emits rss.item.new events for downstream consumers.
long_description: Centralized registry of RSS/Atom sources with health tracking, quality scoring, and a built-in catalog of curated feeds. Items are fetched periodically based on each feed's update_frequency, deduplicated by guid/link, and stored for downstream consumers (the rss-reader app, agents, the research engine, notifications).
author: Kernl
